messages:
sarah: Heads-up — planning to onboard model `orion-4b-q4` to model-catalog tomorrow 10:30 PST. Need someone to run the deploy, who can own smoke checks & rollback if anything weird. Also planning a 5% canary for 30m.

dave: I can take the deployer role. I'll be around 10:15–11:30 PST. What are the exact smoke steps?

lee: Quick Q — are we pinning a specific HF sha or the quantized artifact? Need to know fallback mapping for the routing policy.

priya: We should pin the q4f16 artifact (same quant profile we used for atlas-3b last month). Fallback should be `orion-4b-fp16` and then `small-backup-2b`. I'll post the catalog snippet.

infra-bot: FYI reserved 1xA100 pool for the canary window (10:25–11:00 PST). Autoscaler will not evict during canary.

deploy-bot: preflight checks triggered: unit tests, model-signature-verify, pipeline-smoke. Will report back with a PASS/FAIL summary.

sarah: Snippet for model-catalog entry (for the record):

```yaml
model_id: orion-4b-q4
version: v2026-03-12-q4f16
pin: true
fallbacks:
  - orion-4b-fp16
  - small-backup-2b
canary:
  percent: 5
  duration: 1800  # seconds
health_checks:
  - /v1/health/model
  - /v1/generate?prompt=smoke
```

sarah: Smoke command (dev console):
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"orion-4b-q4","input":"smoke test: hello"}' | jq .
```
Expected minimal output: `{\"choices\":[{\"text\":\"hello\"}]}` (we'll check latency and token continuity).

dave: Sounds good. I'll run the deploy and post timestamps. I'll also run the smoke command against canary endpoint and paste results.

lee: I'll update the rollout policy in the console to ensure routing fallback is enabled and pin is set, then set an automatic rollback if error_rate > 1% or p95 latency increases by >200ms.

priya: Please watch these metrics during canary: p50/p95 latency, 5-min error rate, token-cost per 1k, and coherent-response-rate (score from evals). I'll have eval harness running in the background with our canary prompt set.

deploy-bot: preflight summary: unit-tests PASS, signature-verify PASS, pipeline-smoke FAIL on one path (streaming chunk handling) — mark @dave to review streaming handler PR #482.

dave: On it. I can patch the streaming handler in the next 20m. If we can't get it green, I'd prefer to delay 1 hour and avoid partial canary.

sarah: Good catch — let's not risk a half-broken streaming path. Delay to 11:30 PST if fix takes more than 20m. If dave's fix is quick, we keep 10:30.

lee: Once patched, I'll re-run preflight. If all green, we do a 5% canary -> monitor for 30m -> then 50% for 15m -> full. Manual hold between steps.

priya: I'll have the evals auto-report regressions and post a summary to this thread. If any prompt set drops by >2% quality, abort and rollback to `orion-4b-fp16`.

dave: Patch pushed to main, PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/489 — rolling unit + smoke now.

deploy-bot: re-run preflight: all checks PASS.

sarah: Great — I'm going to ping ops and kick at 11:30 PST to give a little buffer. dave, lee, priya please be on watch for the next 45m. tagging: @dave @lee @priya :thumbsup:

lee: Acknowledged — monitoring console and alerting thresholds set.

priya: Ready with eval dashboards.

dave: Ready to deploy and rollback if needed.

sarah: Thanks team — will post canary run timestamps and smoke outputs in this thread when I start.
